YSI600R
======

wiki:devices/tribox

The YSI600R measures water temperature, pH and conductivity. 
The device reports the measured values to a RS232 connection. 
The electrical connection is controlled by the wiki:devices/wago, output 1
indicated by a green LED.

## Maintanance

Clean throughflow cell when necessary 

## Serial number
???

Port
----
/dev/ttyUSB2

Probe configuration
-------
 - Automatic realtime measurement start every 1s
 - Decimal comma off
 - Protocol:
    - Column 1: Date (ignored)
    - Column 2: Time (ignored)
    - Column 3: Temperature [degC]
    - Column 4: Conductivity [µS/cm]
    - Column 5: pH [-]
